'''Denkra Kymeri''', who later assumed the name of '''Voidsister Warrior''', was a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Witch/Legends|Witch]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], she was a member of the [[Howling Crag Clan]], which was headed by the [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]] [[Amaya Kymeri]]. During the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|blackwing virus]], Denkra Kymeri became infected along with many members of the clan, and in an attempt to contain the outbreak, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the clan. However, Kymeri, along with two of her sisters, [[Naija Kymeri]] and [[Thestriel Kymeri]], formed the [[Sisters of the Void]], used spells to fight off the contagion, and took on new names, Denkra's being "Voidsister Warrior". Gradually, they began to lose the battle, and eventually, the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Amaya Kymeri sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill the three sisters.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denkra Kymeri appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Denkra Kymeri was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced upon the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]] on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
